title: Bouncefold
creation_method: MusicSaas Gateway game_bgm / SA3 small stereo master; first 64 seconds form the game mix, full single-pass 128-second master forms the station mix; -4 dB gain before AAC encoding. PCM preflight cannot independently prove inference mode or musical quality; human review remains required.
generation_prompt: This is a continuous excerpt from the MIDDLE of an already-playing full-volume song, not an intro. At time 0.0 a strong kick, full bass, crisp hat-and-snare pattern, bright four-note hook and chord stabs are ALREADY playing at their normal chorus volume. Sustain that full energy through the first 16 seconds and the final 16 seconds; do not introduce or fade out any stem. The first and last beats both have complete drums, bass, chords and a melodic hook at stable level. Create one ORIGINAL 128-second stereo FUTURE BASS instrumental for an all-ages one-or-two-key rhythm game at STRICT constant 140 BPM in 4/4. Use a clean kick on each quarter beat, a crisp snare on beats two and four, eighth-note hats, short midrange pluck on each quarter beat, rounded sub-bass and buoyant sidechained chord swells behind the transients. Signature hook: two upward springy marimba-like notes launch a four-note folded-synth reply, then a single high note drops into a low answer; leave a clear breath before each reply. At 64 seconds preserve full groove and volume, change harmonic roots and trade the register of the two phrases, with a fresh rhythmic answer rather than a duplicated half. Keep distinct beat attacks across every 8-second span. No quiet intro, soft build, half-time break, filter fade, silent tail, tempo drift, abrasive distortion, vocals, speech, samples, known melody or imitation of another song.

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Original high-contrast comic-print cover: one folded ivory paper-ribbon spring rising from a coral square impact pad, with exactly three cyan arc echoes and one yellow release dot. Compact distinct geometry inside the mobile crop; no figures, scenery, letters or borrowed symbols.
